playbooks.name: VP Reversal + OF Absorption
playbooks.setup: Failed auction or sharp rejection at VAH, VAL, HVN, or POC with profile structure showing reversal context.

entry.name: Reversal Confirmation Entry
entry.trigger: Enter after rejection confirms and absorption, big limit order behavior, or cumulative delta divergence validates the reversal.
confirmationRequired: Rejection candle or failed auction confirmation
Absorption, big limit order, or cumulative delta divergence
invalidIf: Price accepts beyond the failed level
Order flow confirms the original move instead of the reversal

stop.name: Failed Auction Protective Stop
stop.placement: Beyond the failed auction extreme or rejection wick, using the farthest meaningful barrier between profile edge and swing.

management.name: Reversal Risk Compression
management.breakEvenAfter: TP1 or first clean reaction away from the failed level
management.trailAfter: TP2 once reversal expands beyond value
earlyExitIf: Price accepts beyond the failed level
forceFlatIf: Funding hazard or macro hazard is near

requiredContext: Nearby POC, HVN, VAH, or VAL
requiredConfirmations: Cumulative delta divergence or failed continuation read
rejectIf: Stop cannot be placed behind a clear failed level

playbooks.name: VP Accumulation + OF Volume Cluster
playbooks.setup: Sideways accumulation zone forms with a POC or HVN inside the range and a breakout/retest context around a volume cluster.

entry.name: Accumulation Breakout Retest
entry.trigger: Enter after breakout from accumulation and retest of POC, HVN, or cluster confirms hold from the new side.
confirmationRequired: Retest hold at POC, HVN, or volume cluster
invalidIf: Price accepts back into the accumulation range
Retest slices through the level without reaction

stop.name: Accumulation Range Stop
stop.placement: Beyond the opposite side of the accumulation range or behind VAL for longs and VAH for shorts, with a small basis-point buffer.

target.name: Accumulation Expansion Targets
target.target1: Nearest HVN or first profile barrier

management.name: Accumulation Hold Management
management.trailAfter: New HVNs form in trend direction
earlyExitIf: Price accepts back into the accumulation range
forceFlatIf: Range acceptance returns with no continuation

requiredConfirmations: Volume cluster acting as support or resistance

playbooks.name: VP Trend + VWAP Pullback + Aggressive Delta
playbooks.setup: Trend profile is directional, VWAP is aligned with the move, and pullback reaches a profile level, VWAP, or prior acceptance zone.

entry.name: Trend Pullback Continuation
entry.trigger: Enter after pullback to VWAP, deviation, or profile level holds and aggressive delta resumes in the trend direction.
invalidIf: Price accepts back into prior value
Delta flips against continuation at the retest

stop.name: Trend Pullback Barrier Stop
stop.placement: Beyond the pullback swing, VWAP barrier, or profile level that should hold, whichever is farthest and structurally cleanest.

management.name: Trend Continuation Management
management.trailAfter: TP1 or TP2 when continuation proves itself
earlyExitIf: Delta divergence appears against the trade
Price accepts back into prior value

requiredContext: Pullback into profile or VWAP support/resistance

playbooks.name: VP Rejection + Cumulative Delta Divergence
playbooks.setup: Price tests VAH, VAL, HVN, LVN, or POC and rejects, while cumulative delta diverges from price at the rejection point.

entry.name: Rejection Divergence Entry
entry.trigger: Enter after the rejection candle confirms and cumulative delta divergence shows failed participation in the tested direction.
invalidIf: Price accepts past the rejected level
Divergence disappears on the next push

stop.name: Rejection Wick Stop
stop.placement: Beyond the rejection wick or failed auction extreme, with a buffer beyond the level that should hold.

management.name: Rejection Rotation Management
management.trailAfter: Only after TP2 if rotation expands
earlyExitIf: Price accepts beyond the rejected level
No reaction away from POC after entry
forceFlatIf: Macro or funding hazard is near while still in local value

requiredContext: VAH, VAL, HVN, LVN, or POC test
rejectIf: Rejected level is not structurally clear

playbooks.name: Unfinished Business Revisit
playbooks.setup: An unfinished high or low exists and price later revisits that level, creating a chance to trade the revisit after confirmation rather than the first print.

entry.name: UB Revisit Confirmation
entry.trigger: Enter only after the unfinished level is revisited and held or rejected with clear response.
confirmationRequired: Revisit of unfinished high or low
Reaction candle or supporting order-flow response
invalidIf: Revisit chops through the level without clear response
Liquidity disappears and the revisit loses structure

stop.name: Unfinished Level Stop
stop.placement: Beyond the unfinished level with a small buffer beyond the auction extreme.

target.name: Auction Completion Targets
target.target3: VWAP or next meaningful profile barrier

management.name: UB Revisit Management
management.breakEvenAfter: First meaningful reaction away from the unfinished level
management.trailAfter: Only after the auction completion move is underway
earlyExitIf: Revisit fails and price accepts through the unfinished level

rejectIf: No plan for stop behind the unfinished level

playbooks.name: VWAP First Touch Combo
playbooks.setup: Price approaches VWAP from the correct side and the first touch lines up with a volume-profile level, order-flow confirmation, or price-action structure.

entry.name: VWAP First Touch Combo Entry
entry.trigger: Enter on the first VWAP touch only when confluence exists with profile or order-flow context.
confirmationRequired: Volume Profile or Order Flow confluence
invalidIf: VWAP is touched in chop without reaction

stop.name: VWAP Combo Barrier Stop
stop.placement: Beyond VWAP plus the recent swing or ATR-style structural buffer, choosing the farthest meaningful barrier.

target.name: VWAP Combo Targets
target.target2: Next VWAP deviation or profile barrier

management.name: VWAP First Touch Management
management.trailAfter: Only after TP1 if move proves itself
forceFlatIf: No confluence remains at the touch

requiredContext: At least one profile or order-flow confluence

playbooks.name: VWAP Successful Reaction
playbooks.setup: Price touches VWAP and reacts away, creating a safer entry than a blind first touch.

entry.name: VWAP Reaction Candle Entry
entry.trigger: Enter after the VWAP touch reacts and a confirmation candle closes in the reaction direction.
invalidIf: Price accepts through VWAP after touch

stop.name: VWAP Reaction Stop
stop.placement: Beyond the reaction swing or just beyond VWAP if that is the level that should hold.

management.name: VWAP Reaction Management
forceFlatIf: VWAP loses relevance and price returns to chop

playbooks.name: VWAP Deviation Rotation
playbooks.setup: Price rotates between VWAP and the first deviation in a range, creating fade opportunities back toward fair value.

entry.name: Deviation Rotation Entry
entry.trigger: Fade the first deviation back toward VWAP after price reacts from the deviation instead of accepting beyond it.

stop.name: Deviation Extreme Stop
stop.placement: Beyond the deviation extreme that should not be accepted if rotation remains valid.

target.name: Deviation Rotation Targets
target.target3: Optional full range extension if rotation persists

management.name: Deviation Rotation Management
management.trailAfter: Only after VWAP is reclaimed and move continues
forceFlatIf: Rotational context is replaced by a strong trend

requiredContext: Rotational market between VWAP and first deviation

playbooks.name: VWAP Trend Deviation Continuation
playbooks.setup: Strong trend pulls back to the first VWAP deviation and uses that deviation as continuation support or resistance.

entry.name: Trend Deviation Continuation Entry
entry.trigger: Enter after pullback to first deviation confirms continuation with supportive price action or aligned order-flow behavior.
invalidIf: Momentum fades or delta diverges against the move

stop.name: Trend Deviation Protective Stop
stop.placement: Beyond the deviation and the pullback swing, using the strongest barrier among deviation, swing, profile level, and ATR-style fallback.

management.name: Trend Deviation Management
management.trailAfter: TP2 or once the extension is underway
forceFlatIf: Price accepts back through deviation and trend weakens
